findingDetails.title: A started-command row selected by --row-id is logged under the pre arm
findingDetails.scopeProof: Both runner and scorer are in scope; only the arm label of a selected row is involved.

findingDetails.title: --backfill replays a started-command row with the default fixture path even when the run used a custom --fixture
findingDetails.scopeProof: Confined to the runner's fixture selection and backfill prompt lookup; the backfill module is read-only context.

findingDetails.title: The capture leaves its environment projection installed after it returns
findingDetails.scopeProof: Inside the capture module and its own header claim; the slice test is its in-process caller.

findingDetails.title: measure-brief-cost.mjs measures the child-session brief when it runs from a dispatched worker
findingDetails.scopeProof: Confined to the cost script and the renderer child branch it depends on.

spec_code.notes: Baseline structure unchanged; the four findings are harness behaviour, not baseline drift.

checklist_evidence.notes: No parent checklist; phase 007 closure note remains the only evidence.

skill_agent.notes: No agent definition owns the area.

agent_cross_runtime.notes: Arm and fixture defects are runtime-independent; no new per-runtime claim.

noveltyJustification: First line-by-line pass over the changed correctness code; all four findings are new and none is a restatement of a pass-one item.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Multi-file measurement harness with concrete command-line inputs; not trivial.

targetSelection.selectionReason: These are the files marked yes in review-scope-2.txt whose changed regions the correctness dimension owns.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A g2 row selected by --row-id is labelled with the default arm.

searchActions.result: assertRunnable accepts g2 ids; armFor keys only on options.set; main calls armFor after selection

searchLedger.rationale: A selected g2 row reaches the run loop with set null and becomes arm pre.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The backfill re-derives a different fixture path than the run used.

searchActions.result: run uses options.fixture; backfill uses resolve(dirname(backfill),'g2-fixture'); no fixture recorded

searchLedger.rationale: A custom fixture is invisible to the backfill, so the replayed prompt can differ.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The capture's env projection survives the call and its deleted db dir is still referenced.

searchActions.result: env written and deleted, finally restores only Date and removes dbDir

searchLedger.rationale: The header claims a caller inherits no setup; the environment outlives the call.

searchLedger.hypothesis: AI_SESSION_CHILD reaches the hook and changes the measured head.

searchActions.result: env spreads process.env; renderer picks child session from the same variable

searchLedger.rationale: A dispatched worker measures the downgraded brief and reports it as live.

searchLedger.hypothesis: parseOffer appends a following word to the command.

searchActions.result: optional second word exists, but renderer heads place a policy or a digit after the command

searchLedger.rationale: Not reachable from the renderer's own head shape.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: renderer output never places a bare word after the command

searchLedger.hypothesis: A non-Claude runtime's offer is replayed with the Claude hook.

searchActions.result: the replay is documented as the Claude prompt hook by design

searchLedger.rationale: Documented design; re-reporting would repeat a deferred item.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: design documented in the area README
